title: The AI Supply Chain Post Elections
gist: Teaser (truncated, ~200 words) by Tan Kai Xian and Will Denyer: the US midterms boosted political support for data center construction restrictions, raising the question of whether the AI capex boom slows or halts. Federal risk is limited since Trump would veto anti-AI bills, and lame-duck permitting reform (Bipartisan American Affordability And Jobs Act) could loosen power-infrastructure constraints on data center growth.
